title: A great add-on to our honeymoon!
text: What a wonderful experience! We had a wonderful time and can’t recommend this enough!! The guys were courteous and extremely professional. They took care of us every step of the way and made the experience even better. Had a joyous time adding this to our honeymoon experience in Barcelona!
author: 61akashk

title: A wonderful experience
text:
The activity was spectacular, in every sense. From the beginning, Kam picked us up in Barcelona and drove us to Vic. He is a very kind person, very helpful at all times, making us feel very comfortable, explaining every detail and question we had about the activity while he drove us to Vic to go up in the balloon.

Then, the balloon flight was fascinating; at all times we felt very safe with Kiko, the pilot, who demonstrated all his capability to us. It is an unforgettable experience.

Without a doubt, I would recommend this tour; it is worth every penny, the people who work there do their job
author: ferchorecalt

title: Brutal
text:
An absolutely unforgettable experience. Watching the sunrise from a balloon is hard to describe: the tranquility, the views, and the feeling of floating in silence make it a truly magical moment.

The entire team was very professional and approachable at all times, conveying safety and making us enjoy the experience from the first minute. The organization was impeccable and they took care of every detail.

Without a doubt, an activity I would recommend 100%. It is a memory I will keep forever and one of the best ways to start the day.

Thanks to Quico and Kam
